text: Everyone says yes to the ten thousand dollar raise. Nobody does the math. Ten thousand extra per year sounds great. But spread across five hundred extra work hours, that is roughly twenty dollars per hour extra. If your current hourly rate is already fifty dollars an hour, you are taking a pay cut. And research shows that beyond fifty hours a week, your productivity does not just slow down. It collapses. Three questions to ask before you say yes. What is my actual hourly rate after this? What is this costing my health and relationships? And can I negotiate the terms instead of just accepting the trade? More money is not always more value.
